options.name: clear_log
options.description: Prevent entries from the log area from being used for the recovery. No log entries from the log area are replayed, and the log area is initialized. As a consequence, the content of the log area is lost. For I(timestamp_backup) prevents the recovery of entries from the log area. No log entries from the log area are replayed, and the log area is initialized. As a consequence, the content of the log area is lost. options.name: database_name
options.description: SAP HANA system tenant or SYSTEMDB to restore. If not provided SYSTEMDB is default value.

options.name: full_backup
options.description: Path to full backup to use for restore. It ends with prefix used to create full backup (full backup consists of multiple files). It can be absolute or relative path. Mutually exclusive with I(timestamp_backup).

options.name: full_backup_type
options.description: Path to full backup to use for restore.

options.name: hana_db_system_password
options.description: Password for HANA SYSTEM database user.

options.name: hdbsqluserstore_key
options.description: hdbuserstore record to be used to connect to database.

options.name: timestamp_backup
options.description: Recovers an SAP HANA database to a specific point in time. Timestamp is always in UTC timezone. Example 2022-01-02 11:22:33. Empty string means now. Mutually exclusive with I(full_backup).

options.name: using
options.description: Specify non-default catalog/data/log path. Use if files are mounted on different path then when they were created.
